query: Issue a confined-space entry permit for digester tank T-114 (sludge-rake repair, 2 entrants).
scene:
SITE: Kembla Grange wastewater treatment plant, digester tank T-114.
JOB: replace the sludge-rake bearing. Two entrants, one standby attendant.
HAZARDS: oxygen deficiency, hydrogen sulphide, stored rotational energy, engulfment.
You are the HSE permit agent. Every check you run becomes part of the permit record, which is the evidence a regulator will read after an incident.

steps.label: Tripod and winch rigged
steps.result: Tripod and winch rigged over the hatch, load-tested.

steps.label: Check Ana's certification
steps.result: W-2291 Ana Petrou: confined-space entry cert VALID to 2027-03-11.

steps.label: Radio check
steps.result: Radio check with attendant PASS.

steps.label: Lockout tag on valve 103
steps.result: LOTO tag 8843 in place, padlocked, signed W-3310.

steps.label: Ana fit for duty?
steps.result: Fitness-for-duty current, no restrictions.

steps.label: Rake drive isolated
steps.result: Sludge-rake drive isolated and proved dead.

steps.label: Pump isolated
steps.result: Recirculation pump isolated and proved dead.

steps.label: Breathing set charged
steps.result: SCBA-5 at 295 bar, above the 270 bar minimum.

steps.label: Lockout tag on valve 101
steps.result: LOTO tag 8841 in place, padlocked, signed W-3310.

steps.label: Assign standby attendant
steps.result: W-0876 Jo Whelan assigned as standby attendant, remains outside.

steps.label: Safe lighting rigged
steps.result: Intrinsically-safe lighting rigged, 24 V, RCD-protected.

steps.label: Lockout tag on valve 102
steps.result: LOTO tag 8842 in place, padlocked, signed W-3310.

steps.label: Rescue crew on site
steps.result: Rescue crew on site, 2 members, SCBA-ready.

steps.label: Read the gas safety sheet
steps.result: Digester-gas MSDS reviewed: H2S, CH4, CO2 asphyxiant risk.

steps.label: Read the last permit
steps.result: Previous permit PTW-4102 closed clean on 2026-05-19.

steps.label: Fan 2 running
steps.result: FAN-2 running, 1400 rpm, no alarms.

steps.label: Check the forecast
steps.result: No rain forecast in the 8 h permit window, 16-21 C.

steps.label: Fan 3 running
steps.result: FAN-3 running, 1380 rpm, no alarms.

steps.label: First-aid post staffed
steps.result: First-aid post staffed, eyewash serviced 2026-07-12.

steps.label: Barriers in place
steps.result: Hard barriers and exclusion zone established around the hatch.

steps.label: Warning signs posted
steps.result: Confined-space warning signage posted at both approaches.

steps.label: Personal gas monitors issued
steps.result: Two personal H2S monitors issued, both bump-tested.

steps.label: Look up past incidents
steps.result: Two prior entries logged for T-114, no incidents. One near-miss in 2024 at the adjacent T-113 (H2S spike during de-sludging).

steps.label: Check Sam's certification
steps.result: W-1043 Sam Ozturk: confined-space entry cert VALID to 2026-11-02.

steps.label: Sam fit for duty?
steps.result: Fitness-for-duty current, respirator-cleared.

steps.label: Emergency vehicle standing by
steps.result: Emergency vehicle stationed with clear egress route.

steps.label: Tank purged long enough
steps.result: Continuous purge 47 min, exceeds the 30 min minimum for this volume.

steps.label: Harness inspected
steps.result: Full-body harness HARN-9 inspected, tag current to 2026-12.

steps.label: Gas meter calibrated
steps.result: Calibration cert valid to 2026-09-01. Last bump test 2026-07-30 PASS.

steps.label: Read explosive gas
steps.result: LEL = 2 %. Permit limit <10 %. WITHIN LIMIT.

steps.label: Read hydrogen sulphide
steps.result: H2S = 8.4 ppm. Permit limit 10 ppm. MARGINAL - within limit but above the 5 ppm re-test trigger. Re-test required before entry.

steps.label: Re-test hydrogen sulphide
steps.result: H2S re-test = 4.1 ppm after extended purge. Now below the re-test trigger.

steps.label: Read carbon monoxide
steps.result: CO = 3 ppm. Permit limit 30 ppm. WITHIN LIMIT.

steps.label: Read oxygen
steps.result: O2 = 20.6 % vol. Permit range 19.5-23.5. WITHIN LIMIT.

steps.label: Attach competency records
steps.result: Competency summary for both entrants attached.

steps.label: Attach isolation certificate
steps.result: Isolation certificate ISO-CERT-2291 attached.

steps.label: Attach gas readings
steps.result: Atmospheric log incl. the H2S re-test attached.

steps.label: Attach rescue plan
steps.result: Rescue and retrieval plan RP-114 attached.

steps.label: Brief the entrants
steps.result: Pre-entry brief delivered to both entrants and the attendant, signed.

steps.label: Compile the permit
steps.result: Draft permit PTW-4471 assembled from the checks above.

steps.label: Notify control room
steps.result: Control room notified, T-114 flagged as an active permit space.

steps.label: Get supervisor signature
steps.result: Supervisor W-3310 countersigned the draft.

steps.label: Issue the permit
steps.result: PERMIT PTW-4471 ISSUED. Valid 8 h. Entry authorised.
